name: launch-film
title: Launch film
description: A twenty-second product launch film, from a typed headline to the final mark.

props.name: product
props.doc: The product name: in the headline, the closing line and the wordmark.

props.name: version
props.doc: The version, set in the accent colour in the headline.

props.name: headline
props.doc: The typed headline. {product} and {version} are replaced; the version is set in the accent colour.

props.name: dock
props.doc: The five app icons in the dock, left to right. The product icon joins between the third and fourth.

props.name: prompt
props.doc: The text typed into the prompt box. It wraps at the box width; a newline starts a new line.

props.name: tags
props.doc: The three chips that pop above the prompt box.

props.name: connecting
props.doc: The line scrambled over the dots. {product} is replaced.

props.name: glyphs
props.doc: Loose characters that fly across the dashboard.

props.name: dashWord
props.doc: The word the loose letters settle into on the dashboard.

props.name: dashTitle
props.doc: The dashboard page title.

props.name: dashNav
props.doc: The nine sidebar entries; the seventh is the selected one.

props.name: dashPill
props.doc: The label in the pill beside the logo.

props.name: dashPanel
props.doc: The two lines of the panel at the lower left (the first in small grey capitals).

props.name: dashSearch
props.doc: The placeholder in the panel search field.

props.name: dashTiles
props.doc: The two stat tiles.

props.name: dashCta
props.doc: The coral button at the lower left.

props.name: dashStats
props.doc: The two cards at the top of the dashboard.

props.name: dashRows
props.doc: The six table rows.

props.name: dashCols
props.doc: The two lines repeated in each table column.

props.name: dashAction
props.doc: The outlined button at the end of each row.

props.name: filmTitle
props.doc: The title over the footage box and on the grid. {product} and {version} are replaced.

props.name: tryLine
props.doc: The closing line on the grid, in three words or phrases. {product} and {version} are replaced.

props.name: markLetter
props.doc: The letter that strikes, extrudes, spins and lands as the closing mark. Empty uses the first letter of the product.

props.name: accent
props.doc: The product tile, the version in the headline, the prompt button flash, the mark on black and the call to action.

props.name: ground
props.doc: The light ground.

props.name: ink
props.doc: The text colour on the light ground.

props.name: markA
props.doc: Closing mark gradient, light end.

props.name: markB
props.doc: Closing mark gradient, deep end.

props.name: uiFont
props.doc: Google Fonts family for interface text and the closing letter.

props.name: headlineFont
props.doc: Google Fonts family for the typed headline.

props.name: serifFont
props.doc: Google Fonts family for the wordmark.

props.name: photos
props.doc: Pictures for the poster burst: names of files under public/photos, without ".jpg". The defaults are public-domain artworks and posters from Wikimedia Commons.

props.name: footage
props.doc: The footage shots, in order: names of files under public/photos, without ".jpg". The first two are shown in black and white. The defaults are public-domain photos of runners from Wikimedia Commons.
